summary: SkillBridge Gap Engine tested end-to-end. All backend endpoints (auth, roles, skills extraction via Gemini, analysis for curated + custom roles, roadmap generation & toggle, dashboard) work correctly. Full frontend wizard flow (auth demo -> dashboard -> 4-step wizard -> results with radar+buckets -> roadmap -> task toggle updates progress) works end-to-end. Note: login/register return token under key 'token' (not 'access_token') and analysis payload requires numeric proficiency (0-100).
passed: GET /api/auth/me with bearer token -> 200 returns user profile
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401 'Invalid email or password'
GET /api/roles/curated -> 8 roles including all expected titles with skills lists
POST /api/skills/extract -> Gemini 3 Flash returned 9+ skills with name/category/proficiency
POST /api/analysis/run curated Fullstack Engineer -> readiness=32, 10 required, strong/gap populated, id persisted
POST /api/analysis/run is_custom=true 'Blockchain Solidity Engineer' -> Gemini generated 10 required skills
PATCH /api/roadmap/{id}/toggle with body {week_index, task_index, completed} -> updates roadmap
GET /api/dashboard -> {latest_analysis, total_analyses, completed_tasks, total_tasks, progress_pct} correct after toggle
Frontend AuthPage: auth-demo-btn creates account and redirects to /dashboard
Frontend Dashboard: empty-state + new-analysis-btn visible; click routes to /wizard
Frontend Wizard: role-fullstack-engineer -> resume-textarea -> extract-skills-btn -> skills-list appears -> run-analysis-btn -> /results/:id
Frontend Results: results-readiness-score='52%', bucket-strong/partial/gap all render, generate-roadmap-btn navigates to /roadmap/:id
Frontend Roadmap: task-0-0 toggle changes roadmap-progress from 0% -> 6% (1/18)
notes: Login/register response uses key 'token' (not 'access_token') — matches frontend api.js interceptor.
SkillOut model requires proficiency as int (0-100). Extraction returns ints; if any client sends strings it will 422.
